method: Hand-curated by a wave-worker from web research (Oct 2026), never by an LLM. verification: 'verified' = 2+ independent sources agree; 'single-source' = one source or creator lore, flagged, not trusted. status: rising/peak/fading for the current cycle; established = long-lived format, not a current surge; evergreen = always-recurring debate template. The pipeline matches topics to families with conservative word-boundary regexes (see pipeline/format_families.py) and re-computes every run, so family links are derived, never stale.
